summary.business: Manipal operates a pan-India network of multispecialty hospitals delivering care from outpatient services to complex tertiary and quaternary interventions. As of September 30, 2025 it ran 38 hospitals (48 on a pro forma basis) with 10,761 licensed beds (12,367 pro forma) across 14 states and union territories. Clinical focus is on tertiary/quaternary care in cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, gastro sciences, orthopedics and renal sciences (CONGO-R).

currentContext.business: Manipal operates a pan-India network of multispecialty hospitals delivering care from outpatient services to complex tertiary and quaternary interventions. As of September 30, 2025 it ran 38 hospitals (48 on a pro forma basis) with 10,761 licensed beds (12,367 pro forma) across 14 states and union territories. Clinical focus is on tertiary/quaternary care in cardiac sciences, oncology, neurosciences, gastro sciences, orthopedics and renal sciences (CONGO-R).
currentContext.expansion: Manipal plans to add approximately 751 licensed beds across existing hospitals and approximately 1,943 licensed beds through greenfield projects by 2030 to support growth. Its network grew from 28 hospitals with 7,699 licensed beds (Mar 31, 2023) to 48 hospitals with 12,367 licensed beds (pro forma, Sep 30, 2025), aided by acquisitions of AMRI (Sep 2023), Medica Synergie (Jul 2024) and Sahyadri (Oct 2025, adding 1,606 beds). In November 2025 it commenced its 49th hospital in Bengaluru, taking licensed capacity to 12,631 beds as of December 31, 2025.
